meta.what: A derivation, not an upstream file: SPC's all-tornadoes file counted as distinct tornadoes per county per year. A tornado counts once in each county any of its rows names: its row, or for a multi-state tornado its state segments (sg = 2), plus its continuation rows past four counties (sg = -9). The whole-track summaries of multi-state tornadoes (sn = 0, sg = 1) are skipped, because their segments name the counties.
meta.source: NOAA/NWS Storm Prediction Center, 1950-2025 all tornadoes (US federal work)
